section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Attitudes Toward Unconventional Sex Scale (ATUSS), a 5-item measure used to assess participants' disposition toward unconventional sexual practices. The scale uses a 7-point Likert response format, and the text reports that Cronbach's alpha was .91 for both women and men in the present study. No demographic, sample, or body appreciation-related information is provided in this section.
